title: Function Calling Deep Dive — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini

questions.question: What shape does to_openai produce for the WEATHER definition?
options: type=function with parameters and strict
A flat object with input_schema and no function wrapper
A functionDeclarations array with an upper-case type field
A JSON string containing only the weather arguments
questions.explanation: The OpenAI adapter wraps the definition as type=function and places the schema and strict flag under function.

questions.question: How does the sample argument payload differ between OpenAI and Anthropic parsing?
options: Both providers always return a Python dict encoded as YAML
OpenAI args are JSON text; Anthropic input is a dict
OpenAI omits arguments and Anthropic supplies a JSON string
Anthropic uppercases every argument value before parsing
questions.explanation: The OpenAI sample has arguments as a JSON string, while Anthropic tool_use already exposes input as a dictionary.

questions.question: Which transformation is specific to to_gemini?
options: It adds a strict boolean and rejects every optional property
It changes the function name to a numeric id
Uppercases scalar type strings; drops additionalProperties
It turns all enum values into null
questions.explanation: The Gemini adapter maps scalar JSON Schema type names to Gemini's upper-case form and deliberately drops additionalProperties.

questions.question: How does the adapter force one named function for Gemini?
options: It sends mode NONE with an empty allow-list
It sends mode AUTO and lets the model choose
It sends the Anthropic tool/name object unchanged
ANY plus allowed_function_names
questions.explanation: Gemini's forced choice uses functionCallingConfig mode ANY plus an allowed_function_names list containing the requested function.

questions.question: What normalized call should parse_openai produce for the bundled get_weather sample?
options: call_abc123 -> get_weather(Bengaluru, celsius)
Call id weather-0, name weather, with no arguments
Call id call_abc123, name get_time, with timezone UTC
A refusal because strict mode forbids JSON arguments
questions.explanation: The sample response names get_weather, uses id call_abc123, and its JSON arguments decode to city Bengaluru and units celsius.

questions.question: Which restriction is part of the lesson's strict OpenAI schema guidance?
options: Strict mode allows arbitrary $ref chains and overlapping oneOf branches
Strict mode avoids $ref and overlapping oneOf branches in the schema
Strict mode requires every tool to use Anthropic's input_schema key
Strict mode disables enum validation for string properties
questions.explanation: The documented strict subset does not support $ref or overlapping oneOf constructs, so schemas must stay within that subset.
